requirement.summary: One reusable task per application type: Single, Joint, Minor (joint with adult), Custodian. Shared data, environment and20 evaluators; each application's actual product selects its workflow, and governing state/charter/date select qualified policies. Optional example state never filters cases. Anvil owns immutable selected dataset binding and counts; no per-application tasks or additive coverage quotas.

profile.handoverName: Reusable application-type KYC workflow with shared application cases

blockers: Exact published template and Anvil runtime/policy qualification required

template.humanGate: Authoring PM/Admin approves task revisions; an optional external Reviewer may precede final approval. Every task in a project must be approved for project export. Template publication does not approve tasks, qualify Anvil execution, or resolve policy applicability/data-rights review.
template.primaryWork: Investigate each application assigned to this reusable application-type KYC workflow through the shared isolated environment; produce one evidence-backed recommendation per application.
template.verificationCriteria: 20 checks at5points each, explicit5/2/0anchors, full100pointdenominator, critical failure override. Anvil evaluates sealed state, recommendation, policy, trace and independent expectations; missing legal/human qualification stays unscored.
